description: Stateful monitor you can call with plain query params: give a token and the public URL of your OpenAPI 3 JSON document; the first call stores a baseline, every later call returns only what changed since your previous call. Repeat-use API monitoring. Price: $0.01 per call in USDC on Base (eip155:8453), paid with x402 in params._meta["x402/payment"]. HTTP: GET https://api.firstmention.uk/s/api-change-check/watch

token.description: Private label for this monitored API, 8-64 chars of letters/digits/-/_

url.description: Public http(s) URL of your OpenAPI 3.0/3.1 JSON document

name: api_change_check__watch
